translation.name: Biblica® Ochiw Thuolo Motingʼo Loko Manyien™

content: Kuom jatend wer. Zaburi mar yawuot Kora.

content.text: Winjuru wachni, un ji duto:
chikuru itu, un duto mudak e pinyni,
un joma odhier kod joma idew,
jo-mwandu gi jodhier machalre:
Dhoga biro wacho weche mag rieko,
weche moa e chunya biro miyo ji winjo tiend weche.
Abiro chiko ita ne ngero moro;
abiro nyiso tiend midhiero mara ka agoyo nyatitina:
En ngʼa monego aluor ka ndalo mag richo obiro,
ka jo-miriambo ma timbegi richo olwora.
Joma oketo genogi kuom mwandu
kendo masungore kuom mwandugi mathoth?
Onge ngʼama nyalo waro ngima nyawadgi
kata manyalo chulo Nyasaye nengo moromo ware.
Nikech yor waro dhano tek ahinya,
maonge nengo madichul marom,
ma dimi odag nyaka chiengʼ
kendo kik odhi e liel.
Nikech ongʼere ne ji duto ni joma riek tho,
mana kaka joma ofuwo gi joma omingʼ,
bende tho mi giwe mwandu ne joma moko.
Lietegi ema biro siko kaka utegi nyaka chiengʼ
kendo ema gibiro dakie higni gi higni ma ok rum,
kata obedo ni negimako lope mathoth koni gi koni.
To ongʼere ni dhano ok siki e piny,
kata obed gi mwandu mathoth machal nade,
to otho mana kaka le bende tho.
Mano e gima biro timore ne joma ogenore kendgi giwegi,
kendo ne joma luwogi, moluwo wechegi. Sela
Gichomo liete mokuny nigi mana kaka rombe
kendo tho biro lokogi chiembe.
Joma ngimagi oriere tir biro loyogi ka piny oru,
to dendgi biro towo e liete,
ka gin mabor gi utegi madongo machalo ute ruodhi.
Anto Nyasaye biro reso chunya mi ogola e liel adier,
obiro kawa mi odhi koda ire. Sela
Kik chunyi thagre ka ngʼato mwandune medore,
kata ka duongʼ mar ode medore;
nikech onge gima obiro kawo odhigo ka otho,
duongʼ ma en-go ok bi dhi kode e liel,
kata obedo ni ne okawore kaka ngʼama ogwedhi kane pod ongima
nikech ji nyaka paki ka mwanduni medore,
to obiro dhi mi oriwre gi tiengʼ machon mar kwerene,
ma ok nyal neno ler mar wangʼ chiengʼ kendo.
Ngʼat man-gi mwandu mathoth to onge winjo,
chalo gi le ma otho.
